title: The Payoff Photograph
staging:
Scene 15 — The Payoff Photograph

13:35–14:20 · 45 sec · Private dining room

Barkington passes a money bag across the table. Trixie captures a clear photograph of the exchange while Neon records the conversation. The exact purpose of the payment remains unclear.

Shots: Close-up money bag → Barkington's fur-covered paw → Shiba accepting payment → camera viewfinder → shutter click → Trixie's reaction.
